text: Ok so i just rebuilt was it suppose to wipe all the tinting out ?
resolution: Confirmed from the running editor that no retopology band preview remains after the rebuild. The current tint and frozen-source ghost are deliberately session-only editor state: topology edits and hot reloads preserve them, while a full process rebuild/cold restart discards them because they are not stored in the model package. This explains the wipe and identifies that the rebuild instruction should have carried an explicit warning before the user restarted.
